knowledgeDocs.title: Restaurant Timings, Location & Contact
knowledgeDocs.content: RESTOSMART is located at MG Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001. We are open 7 days a week from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Dine-in kitchen orders close at 10:30 PM. For inquiries or table reservations, call +91 9876543210 or email info@restosmart.com.

knowledgeDocs.title: Jain & Dietary Cooking Guidelines
knowledgeDocs.content: We take dietary choices very seriously. We offer dedicated Jain preparations (without onion, garlic, or root vegetables) for Masala Dosa (plain/jain aloo), Paneer Butter Masala, Dal Tadka, and Jeera Rice. Please inform your server or mention 'Jain preparation' in the cooking notes during checkout.

knowledgeDocs.title: Allergen & Ingredient Transparency Standards
knowledgeDocs.content: All vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes are prepared in strictly separated cooking vessels with distinct utensils. Dairy products (Paneer, Ghee, Cream, Butter) and Nuts (Cashews in Paneer Butter Masala) are used in select curries. If you have nut or lactose allergies, please consult our staff before placing your order.

knowledgeDocs.title: Table Seating, QR Ordering & Reservation Policy
knowledgeDocs.content: Each table is equipped with a dedicated QR code (e.g. Table 1 to 20). Scanning the code immediately binds your orders to your table number. Customers can also book tables in advance for up to 20 guests via our Reservation page. Reserved tables are held for up to 15 minutes past the booking time slot.
